card.name: Bracketed capital letter opening a quote
card.fires_on: A single letter, usually a capital, that begins an altered quotation inside square brackets or just after an opening quote mark or ellipsis. It appears in quoted prose, where the editor changes the first letter of the original text.

modes.label: Bracketed first letter
modes.description: A letter in square brackets that replaces the original first letter of a quoted sentence.

modes.label: Quote or ellipsis start
modes.description: A capital letter starting a quotation after an opening quote mark or an ellipsis.
